shared.concept_anchor: Meerut lacked strong civilian popular base unlike Awadh

en.display_text:
Which of the following most accurately characterises the nature of the Revolt of 1857 at Meerut in comparison with other major revolt centres such as Awadh?

(a) Meerut became the principal rebel administrative centre in northern India after the outbreak of May 10, 1857
(b) Unlike Awadh, the Meerut revolt was primarily cantonment-driven and lacked the broad civilian and popular social base that characterised the uprising in other centres
(c) Meerut's revolt was the most sustained and widespread of all rebel centres, given that it was the first and strongest hub of anti-British feeling
(d) Meerut was suppressed more rapidly than other centres because of an exceptionally large British garrison stationed there
en.strong_distractor: c — Option (c) is deceptive because Meerut was the first to revolt, and students may assume 'first to revolt' implies it became the strongest or most sustained rebel centre.
elimination_logic: Eliminate (a): Meerut did become active immediately after May 10, but its sepoys quickly marched to Delhi rather than establishing a rebel administration at Meerut — it did not emerge as an independent rebel administrative centre.
Eliminate (c): The revolt at Meerut was primarily a military cantonment uprising — Meerut did NOT have a broad civilian and popular base comparable to Awadh's taluqdars-peasants-sepoys coalition.

Eliminate (d): Meerut was not suppressed earlier than other centres because of superior British strength there — the sepoys voluntarily left for Delhi, leaving Meerut without a sustained rebel presence.
Select (b): The defining characteristic distinguishing Meerut from Awadh and Bihar was its limited civilian and popular base — it was a cantonment-driven military revolt, not a broad social uprising.
en.upsc_trap_explanation: Option (c) exploits the 'first = most important' fallacy. Students who have memorised 'Meerut = first revolt centre' may assume Meerut also had the strongest or most sustained rebel presence. The precise distinction being tested is that Meerut lacked the broad civilian/popular base that made Awadh qualitatively different — Meerut's revolt was cantonment-specific, not socially deep.
en.final_explanation:
Meerut's role in 1857 is best understood in contrast to other major rebel centres.

• Option (a) — Incorrect: Meerut's sepoys marched to Delhi rather than establishing a rebel administration at Meerut — it did not become an independent rebel headquarters.
• Option (b) — Correct: Unlike Awadh (with taluqdars, peasants, and sepoys) or Bihar (with zamindars), Meerut's revolt was cantonment-driven with limited civilian participation. The broad popular base that sustained other centres was absent at Meerut.
• Option (c) — Incorrect: Meerut being 'first' does not mean it had the strongest or most sustained rebel presence. The sepoys' departure for Delhi left Meerut without sustained rebel activity.
• Option (d) — Incorrect: The sepoys left for Delhi voluntarily — not because the British suppressed Meerut rapidly.

Value Addition:
• Meerut's cantonment geography (large British military presence) made it a logical flashpoint but also prevented a sustained civilian uprising.
• The contrast between Meerut (military trigger) and Awadh (social revolution) illustrates why historians debate the revolt's character.
• The tactical decision to march to Delhi rather than consolidate at Meerut is considered by some historians as a missed opportunity for the rebels.

• विकल्प (a) — गलत: मेरठ के सिपाही दिल्ली चले गए, मेरठ में स्वतंत्र विद्रोही प्रशासन स्थापित नहीं हुआ।
• विकल्प (b) — सही: अवध (तिलकदार, किसान, सिपाही) या बिहार (जमींदार) के विपरीत, मेरठ का विद्रोह छावनी-प्रेरित था और नागरिक भागीदारी सीमित थी। अन्य केंद्रों को बनाए रखने वाला व्यापक लोकप्रिय आधार मेरठ में नहीं था।
• विकल्प (c) — गलत: मेरठ का 'पहला' होना इसका सबसे मजबूत या सबसे स्थायी विद्रोही केंद्र होना नहीं दर्शाता। सिपाहियों के दिल्ली जाने से मेरठ में विद्रोही गतिविधि बनी नहीं रही।
• विकल्प (d) — गलत: सिपाही स्वेच्छा से दिल्ली गए, न कि ब्रिटिश द्वारा तेजी से दबाए जाने के कारण।

Value Addition:
• मेरठ की छावनी भौगोलिक स्थिति (बड़ी ब्रिटिश सैन्य उपस्थिति) इसे तात्कालिक ज्वलन बिंदु बनाती है लेकिन स्थायी नागरिक विद्रोह को रोकती है।
• मेरठ (सैन्य प्रेरक) और अवध (सामाजिक क्रांति) के बीच का अंतर इतिहासकारों के विद्रोह के चरित्र पर बहस को दर्शाता है।
• मेरठ में समेकित होने के बजाय दिल्ली मार्च करने का रणनीतिक निर्णय कुछ इतिहासकारों द्वारा विद्रोहियों के लिए एक चूक माना जाता है।
